findings.evidence:
src/components/layout/IntlProviderWithFallback.tsx:18-22
```ts
const getMessageFallback = () =>
  locale === 'vi' ? 'Nội dung đang được cập nhật.' : 'Content is being updated.';
```
Note that three call sites in the manage page already defend against this with Vietnamese-only `||` fallbacks — page.tsx:1987 `{translate('divisions.title') || 'Nội dung thi đấu'}`, page.tsx:2109 `aria-label={translate('divisions.title') || 'Nội dung thi đấu'}`, and BasicInfoTab.tsx:447 `{translate('hideBannerText') || 'Ẩn chữ phủ trên banner công khai'}` — none of which can ever fire, because next-intl never returns an empty string for a present key.
findings.impact: Any missing key is silently replaced by the generic sentence rather than failing loudly, so a regression ships a user-facing placeholder ('Content is being updated.') inside a form label or button with no test or type error. (No missing key was found in the key set I sampled, so this is a latent risk, not a live bug.)
findings.title: Missing translation keys are silently masked by a generic fallback string, hiding catalogue gaps

findings.title: next-intl timeZone is hard-coded to Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, independent of the active locale

Between lines 296 and 320 there is no `<input>`, `<button>`, `<select>` or `tabIndex`; the scroll wrapper has no `role`/`aria-label`/`tabIndex`. - `manage/page.tsx`: very large. Let me count from the output. Lines with Vietnamese: 115, 117, 125, 209, 241, 249, 273, 274, 299, 308, 319, 323, 399, 406, 418, 422, 426, 441, 465(x2), 482, 496, 500, 511, 532, 835, 836, 837, 907, 914, 945, 958, 966, 991, 1008, 1015, 1023, 1035, 1058, 1069, 1083, 1086, 1088, 1104, 1113, 1114, 1127, 1131, 1142, 1148, 1181, 1182, 1183, 1197, 1198, 1213, 1214, 1229, 1230, 1250, 1261, 1262, 1273, 1274, 1294, 1323, 1337, 1365, 1378, 1388, 1394, 1399, 1444, 1468, 1476, 1495, 1523, 1534, 1987, 2069, 2077, 2109, 2113, 2124, 2213, 2248, 2256, 2295, 2301, 2353, 2407, 2408, 2412, 2413, 2430, 2435, 2440, 2453, 2456, 2470, 2471, 2474, 2475, 2476, 2477, 2532, 2546, 2557, 2562, 2572, 2579, 2584, 2593, 2597, 3181, 3261, 3262, 3395, 3403, 3407, 3412, 3424, 3428, 3434, 3448, 3456, 3471, 3477, 3486, 3497, 3508, 3556, 3558, 3563, 3577, 3579, 3587, 3597, 3605, 3689(x2) — that's ~145.

That's a lot; I'll say "≈145 distinct literal-bearing lines". Let me be honest: I'll say "≥140 lines". Actually, to be safe, I'll report counts only for files I can count reliably and label them as "lines containing a Vietnamese literal in non-comment code (approximate, from grep)".

Let me count a few key ones from the grep output I have:
- CourtScheduleBoard.tsx: 249, 250, 253, 265, 402, 406, 407, 408, 574, 576, 578, 583, 588, 607, 631, 651, 692, 759, 760, 793, 1341, 1410, 1413, 1414, 3503, 4044, 4065, 4172, 4339, 4376, 4385, 4405, 4427, 4444, 4525, 4537, 4551, 4555, 4557, 4560, 4565, 4567, 4569, 4577, 4587, 4597, 4607, 4617, 4620, 5013, 6383, ... ≈ 49+

OK, I have enough for a solid count table. I'll present the top files with counts and note the method.

Now let me write the final yield. I need to be careful about the schema:
- findings: array of {severity, title, file, line, evidence, impact, confidence}
- clean: array of strings
- coverage: string

Let me construct the findings list, ranked.

**Findings:**

1. **Critical** — `CourtScheduleBoard.formatMatchTime` hard-codes `'vi-VN'` → all match times on the schedule board render in Vietnamese format even under `en`. file: `src/app/organizer/tournaments/[id]/manage/components/CourtScheduleBoard.tsx`, line 522.

2. **Critical** — Entry-fee modal hard-codes `'vi-VN'` + Vietnamese "Free". `manage/page.tsx:3558`, also 3572, 3579. And the surrounding labels 3556, 3563, 3577, 3587, 3477, 3471, 3456, 3605... Actually the headline locale defect: `toLocaleString('vi-VN')` and `'Miễn phí'`.

3. **Critical** — Payouts page hard-codes `toLocaleDateString('vi-VN')` + `formatCurrency` (utils/format.ts) hard-codes `Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN')` → whole payouts screen is Vietnamese-formatted in `en`. `src/app/organizer/payouts/page.tsx:298` and `src/utils/format.ts:7`.

4. **Important** — `QuickSchedulePanel.tsx:46` uses `new Intl.DateTimeFormat(undefined, ...)` → uses browser locale, not app locale. An `en` app user on a Vietnamese browser gets Vietnamese times.

5. **Important** — Massive hard-coded Vietnamese bypassing i18n across the manage UI. I'll break this into a few findings by area, with the biggest one being the manage page. Let me create a single "Important" finding for the manage page + one for the court/schedule components + one for the venue modals. Actually the task says "list a representative sample with path:line and count per file". Let me make one finding per cluster with counts in the evidence.

6. **Important** — `overflow-x-auto` region with no focusable child and no `tabIndex`/`role`/name: `CourtScheduleBoard.tsx:4639-4648` (top scrollbar) — spacer-only div. WCAG 2.1.1.

7. **Important** — `payouts/page.tsx:278` `overflow-x-auto` around a 5-column table with no focusable descendant → WCAG 2.1.1 + 1.4.10.

8. **Important** — `RegistrationTab.tsx:739-740` `min-w-[680px]` table inside `overflow-x-auto` without `tabIndex`/`role`/name; scroll container not keyboard-addressable (focusable children exist, so partial). Reflow at 320px. I'll mark Important with confidence 0.6.

9. **Important** — `ScheduleGridView.tsx:531` `max-h-[680px] overflow-auto` (no `tabIndex`/`role`/name) wrapping `grid min-w-[760px]`. Minor/Important.

10. **Important** — Hard-coded Vietnamese round/stage labels: `CourtScheduleBoard.tsx:560-564, 576-583, 692`, `CourtWorkspace.tsx:212-238`, `useManageState.ts:391-400`. Under `en`, round filters/round labels stay Vietnamese.

11. **Important** — `CourtSetup.tsx:212` delete-court button is `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100` with no `focus-visible:opacity-100` → invisible to keyboard and on touch. Same for `PermissionsTab.tsx:433`. And `manage/page.tsx:958, 2449, 2582, BasicInfoTab.tsx:510`. WCAG 2.4.7.

12. **Minor** — `{count}` strings without ICU plural in the `en` dictionary → "1 requests", "1 courts selected", "1 teams", "1 participants". en.json:5523, 8507, 8422, 8620, 7779, 8279.

13. **Minor** — `text-[10px]` in `RegistrationTab.tsx:1014` (below 12px) and `text-[11px]` in several files.

14. **Minor** — `manage/page.tsx:314-372` etc. `timeZone: 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'` hard-coded in `request.ts:11`.

15. **Minor** — Truncation destroying meaning: `payouts/page.tsx:300` `max-w-[200px] truncate` on tournament name (no `title`); `manage/page.tsx:2034` `min-w-0 flex-1 truncate whitespace-nowrap` on division name (no title); `SponsorSettingsPanel.tsx:215` `truncate` on sponsor name. These hide content with no way to read the full value.

16. **Minor** — `whitespace-nowrap` on tab labels: `BasicInfoTab.tsx:210-262`, `TournamentSettingsTab.tsx:129,142` — these are inside horizontal scrollers so they scroll; acceptable. Actually `manage/page.tsx:2488` tab buttons `whitespace-nowrap` in a flex row at 2470-2477 — the container? Let me not claim without reading. I'll list as clean-ish/skip.

17. **Minor** — `IntlProviderWithFallback.getMessageFallback` silently substitutes "Content is being updated." for a missing key — masks missing keys and shows placeholder copy to users. Minor.

18. **Minor** — `CourtScheduleBoard.tsx:4648-4652` dummy spacer `width: ${72 + courts.length * 310}px` — hard-coded px that can desync from the actual `gridTemplateColumns: 72px repeat(n, minmax(310px, 1fr))` used at 4690 (which uses `1fr` so actual width grows with container). At 400% zoom this scrollbar surrogate overflows the real board. That's a genuine reflow bug. Let me double check: grid at 4688-4690 is `grid min-w-[900px]` with `gridTemplateColumns: 72px repeat(n, minmax(310px,1fr))`. The outer container is `overflow-x-auto`. The `1fr` will expand to fill the container width if the container is wider. So the actual scrollWidth ≥ 72 + n*310. The top scrollbar spacer is exactly 72 + n*310 → slightly narrower than actual board when container > min. Minor mismatch → the sticky top scrollbar under-scrolls. Confidence moderate. I'll report as Minor with 0.55.

**CLEAN items:**
- `layout.tsx:140` `<html lang={locale}>` — correct, dynamic from `getLocale()` (cookie `NEXT_LOCALE`, default `vi`), matches the message bundle loaded in `request.ts:12`. No `dir` needed (both locales LTR). ✅
- No `export const viewport` and no `user-scalable`/`maximum-scale` anywhere in the repo (grep over `web/` returned zero matches) → pinch-zoom not blocked. Next.js default viewport meta is `width=device-width, initial-scale=1`. ✅
- All translation keys I sampled resolve in both `messages/vi.json` and `messages/en.json` (verified against full namespace reads): `OrganizerTournaments`, `OrganizerPayouts`, `SeriesCreate`, `SeriesList`, `OrganizerSeriesManage`, `OrganizerManage.{wideSections,divisions,lockModal,createDivision,matchSchedule,courtSetup*,venueNotSet,allStages,allLegs,allRounds,chooseCourts,selectedCourtsHint,selectedCourtCount,clearAllCourts,selectAllCourts,applyCourtSelection,savedVenue*,attach*Venue*,scorePreview,scoreBoardSet,scoreEdit,finalRound,semiFinalRound}`, `TournamentDetail.{liteShortDesc,strictShortDesc,numberOfGroups,groupStageRounds,teamsPerGroup,teamsAdvancing,playoffFormat,singleElimination,doubleElimination,seedingType,seededByElo,randomSeeding,*Format,cannotChangeFormat,registrationLimit,roundRobinWarning}`, `OrganizerLivestream.{ready,waitingSignal,live}`, `OrganizerBasicInfo.{hideBannerText,hideBannerTextDescription,logoPreview,...}`, `Common.{loading,cancel,statusDraft,statusCancelled,configurationOverview}`, `OrganizerOps.viewTournamentPage`. → no missing keys found.
- Interpolation variable names match: e.g. `en.json:8423 advanceSummary: "{groups} groups · top {advancing} → {total} teams"` vs `DivisionGroupStageSettings.tsx:102` passing `{groups, advancing, total}`; `en.json:8424 quickSuggestion` vs line 105; `en.json:8592 scoreBoardSet: "S{n}"` vs `CourtScheduleBoard.tsx:5934` `{ n: setIndex + 1 }`; `en.json:8619 step1DescCount: "{count} players..."`; `OrganizerSeriesManage.defaultLegName: "Leg {count}"` vs `series/[id]/manage/page.tsx:104`. No mismatch found.
- `vi.json` and `en.json` have byte-identical line structure for every namespace (all namespace start/end line numbers line up after a single constant 4-line offset introduced in the `SeriesCreate` block), i.e. key sets are in 1:1 correspondence — no locale drift.
- Mobile sidebar: `TournamentManageSidebar.tsx:324-334, 336-350` — mobile menu trigger, overlay scrim with `aria-label`, close button, `aria-label` on `<aside>`, `lg:w-[250px]` only at lg. Functionality relocated, not dropped. ✅
- Breakpoint-hidden affordances: `manage/page.tsx:2461-2464` + `2844-2847` render the same metadata/contact cards in the mobile container that also appear in the desktop container at `2850-2854` — nothing is lost. Loading skeletons at `706/753` also have both variants. ✅
- `CourtScheduleBoard.tsx:4683-4685` main board scroll region correctly has `role="region"`, `aria-label={t('matchSchedule.court')}`, `tabIndex={0}`. ✅
- `ManageWideOverlay.tsx:105` uses `w-[90vw] h-[96vh]` (viewport-relative) and `104` fullscreen uses `fixed inset-0` — no fixed px width that breaks reflow. ✅
- `BracketSetupModal.tsx:400` and `RosterImportModal.tsx:412` use `w-[96vw] max-h-[94vh]` — reflows with zoom. ✅
- Locale-aware number formatting IS done properly in `FinanceTab.tsx:50-51, 82, 108` (`useLocale()` → `numberLocale`), `RegistrationTab.tsx:1007, 1188, 1193`, `manage/page.tsx:3050, 3056, 3072`, `series/page.tsx:135`, `series/[id]/manage/page.tsx:311`, `tournaments/page.tsx:699`, `CourtCameraBoard.tsx:409, 189`, `TournamentDraftDetails.tsx:40`. ✅
- Horizontal tab scrollers that DO contain focusable children: `BasicInfoTab.tsx:205`, `TournamentSettingsTab.tsx:124`, `VenueCourtsModal.tsx:136`, `RosterPreviewTable.tsx:38`, `RosterColumnMappingStep.tsx:295` (its `overflow-x-auto` at 295 does contain no focusable child, but the table is `min-w-full` with `max-w-[220px] truncate` cells so overflow is bounded — flagged as Minor not listed as a defect... hmm, I should list it as a Minor finding or note it. I'll put it in clean with the caveat? No — better to be honest: put it as a Minor finding with low confidence. Actually the instruction says "If you are unsure whether something is a bug, say so explicitly with your confidence level." I'll add it as Minor conf 0.4.

Hmm, let me limit findings to a manageable, high-value set. Let me finalize ~20 findings.

Also B4: `hover:`-only actions with no touch/keyboard equivalent:
- `CourtScheduleBoard.tsx:4560, 4569` `hidden md:inline` on the "Trước"/"Sau" labels — the buttons remain, only text labels hidden, and they have `aria-label`. Clean.
- `manage/page.tsx:1131, 1148` etc.
- `CourtSetup.tsx:212` and `PermissionsTab.tsx:433` — genuine: opacity-0 hover-only buttons, no `focus-visible` reveal → touch users can't see them either (no hover on touch). Important.
- `manage/page.tsx:1072, 1117, 1133, 1150` — `<Pencil className="... opacity-0 group-hover/row:opacity-100">` decorative only, parent is clickable. Decorative — not a defect. Skip.
- `BasicInfoTab.tsx:510` — the remove-gallery button is `absolute inset-0 ... opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100` covering the image; the parent image is not clickable. On touch, the remove button is invisible (opacity-0) but still hit-testable... opacity-0 elements are still clickable, so functionally reachable, just invisible. And not focus-revealed. Real defect (WCAG 2.4.7). Include.
- `SponsorSettingsPanel.tsx:257` — `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100` overlay over the logo; the underlying control is a label+input? Let me not claim; skip.
- `manage/page.tsx:2449` — the banner "click anywhere to change" overlay is `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100`; but the whole banner is also clickable? Line 2448 `onClick={() => bannerFileInputRef.current?.click()}` on the same div. So clicking works. But keyboard: the div has onClick and no tabIndex/role → not keyboard reachable. That's the a11y agent's area, but it also has a hard-coded Vietnamese label. I'll mention the Vietnamese only.

OK, also `manage/page.tsx:956` — the "Đổi logo" hover overlay text is hard-coded Vietnamese. Include in the Vietnamese cluster.

Let me now write the final answer. I'll make the Vietnamese clustering 3 findings:
- F-A: manage page (≈145 literal lines)
- F-B: court/schedule/bracket components (CourtScheduleBoard ≈49, ScheduleGridView ≈28, CourtWorkspace ≈16, CourtSetup ≈16, BracketSetupModal ≈4, ScheduleTab ≈21)
- F-C: venue/finance/settings modals (CreateVenueModal ≈19, EditVenueModal ≈20, VenueCourtsModal ≈20, TournamentSettingsTab ≈8, SponsorSettingsPanel ≈9, useManageState ≈17)

And locale-fallback direction: under `en`, these show Vietnamese; under `vi` (the default!) these are fine. So the primary broken direction is English. Good.

Now, one more important thing: `defaultLocale = 'vi'`. So Vietnamese is default; the English locale is the secondary. That contextualizes severity: these are "English locale is broken" defects, not "Vietnamese is broken". I'll state that.

Let me write the yield now.

For file paths, I'll use repo-relative paths from the web root: e.g. `src/app/organizer/tournaments/[id]/manage/components/CourtScheduleBoard.tsx`.

Let me double-check a couple of line numbers:

- utils/format.ts line 7: `return new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', {` — let me verify. The file: line 1-4 comment, 5 `export const formatCurrency = ...`, 6 `if (...)`, 7 `return new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN', {`. Yes, line 7. ✅
- QuickSchedulePanel.tsx:46. ✅

- IntlProviderWithFallback.tsx lines 20-22. ✅

Alright. Writing the yield.

METHOD NOTES / HONEST LIMITS: This was a read-only static audit — I did not run the app, switch locales, or execute any build/lint/test. Hard-coded-string counts are counts of *source lines containing a Vietnamese diacritic in non-comment code*, from a regex that excludes lines that start a `//` or `/*` comment; they are LOWER BOUNDS because the pattern also drops any line containing a `/` before the Vietnamese text, and they include a few non-user-facing data-matching strings (`useManageState.ts:391-400`, `manage/page.tsx:209`, `CourtScheduleBoard.tsx:574/588/607/651`) that are slug comparisons rather than copy. Treat the counts as an order-of-magnitude signal, not an exact figure.

The i18n key-completeness conclusion is based on the ~150 keys I enumerated above, not an exhaustive extraction of every t()/translate() call in the tree.
clean: layout.tsx `lang` attribute — CORRECT. src/app/layout.tsx:140 `<html lang={locale} className={\`h-full antialiased ${inter.variable}\`} suppressHydrationWarning>` where line 89 is `const locale = await getLocale();`. getLocale() resolves through src/i18n/request.ts:6-11 from the NEXT_LOCALE cookie, which is the same value used to pick the messages bundle on line 12, so the announced language can never disagree with the rendered content.
No `dir` attribute on `<html>` — CORRECT, both shipped locales (vi, en) are LTR, so the HTML default of ltr is right and adding one would be noise.

Viewport meta / pinch-zoom — NOT BLOCKED. Three call sites in the manage page already defend against this with Vietnamese-only `||` fallbacks — manage/page.tsx:1987 `{translate('divisions.title') || 'Nội dung thi đấu'}`, manage/page.tsx:2109 `aria-label={translate('divisions.title') || 'Nội dung thi đấu'}`, and BasicInfoTab.tsx:447 `{translate('hideBannerText') || 'Ẩn chữ phủ trên banner công khai'}` — none of which can ever fire, because next-intl never returns an empty string for a present key.
findings.impact: Any future missing key is silently replaced by the generic sentence rather than failing loudly, so a catalogue regression ships a user-facing placeholder ('Content is being updated.') inside a form label or button with no test or type error. (No missing key exists in the set I sampled, so this is latent risk, not a live bug.)
findings.title: Missing translation keys are silently masked by a generic fallback string, hiding catalogue gaps

findings.impact: For the `en` locale the server-side date default remains Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh while client-side `toLocaleDateString(locale)` calls use the browser timezone, so a date can render one day apart between the server-rendered and client-updated organizer views.
findings.title: next-intl timeZone hard-coded to Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, independent of the active locale
